content.title: Plan /status endpoint and E2E environment guard
content.description:
Plan the /status endpoint and the E2E guard that consumes it.

Endpoint design:
- GET /api/status returns { agentrackPath: <resolved cwd> }.
- Decide where the cwd value comes from: reuse the resolution in server/utils/tracker.ts (export it, or a shared config) so the endpoint and the Tracker singleton agree. Add a StatusResponse type to server/types.ts.

Guard design:
- In e2e/global-setup.ts or setup.ts, fetch http://localhost:5001/api/status (the E2E API port after the ports deliverable lands) and compare agentrackPath to the project's real .agentrack/ path (<projectRoot>/.agentrack). If they match, abort the run (throw in globalSetup).
- Verify Playwright starts webServers BEFORE globalSetup runs, so the fetch has a target. If that ordering cannot be guaranteed, define a safe fallback (e.g. treat a fetch failure as 'isolation unverified -> abort').
- Note how the guard gets the expected API port (5001) without hardcoding magic numbers where possible.

Output the plan as a comment. Do not make code changes in this phase.

content.reason: Blocker issue mqh2hwglif transitioned to done

content.content:
PLAN: /status endpoint + E2E environment guard

This is the plan for implementer issue mqh2hweq9n. No code changed in this phase.

====================================================================
CURRENT STATE (verified 2026-06-16)
====================================================================
- server/utils/tracker.ts ALREADY exports `cwd` (= process.env.AGENTRACK_CWD || process.cwd()). Reuse it — do NOT re-resolve.
- server/routes/health.ts ALREADY returns `cwd` in HealthResponse. This was an interim guard. /status becomes the authoritative source.
- e2e/global-setup.ts ALREADY polls /api/health and asserts body.cwd === getE2EDataDir(). This must be migrated to /api/status.
- NO server/routes/status.ts exists yet. NO StatusResponse type exists yet.
- e2e/setup.ts exposes getE2EDataDir(), getProjectRoot(). E2E_SEED_TAG and cleanupE2ESeeds() already exist.
- playwright.config.ts: backend webServer on port 5001 with env { AGENTRACK_CWD: e2eDataDir, PORT: "5001" }. frontend on 5000 with API_PORT: "5001".

====================================================================
DECISION 1 — /status vs /health
====================================================================
Add a NEW /api/status route as the AUTHORITATIVE environment/isolation endpoint. /health stays a pure liveness probe.

To avoid two sources of truth, REMOVE `cwd` from HealthResponse and from the health route response. The guard moves to /status. Health keeps { status, tracker } only.

Rationale: health = "is the server up?", status = "what is the server pointed at?". Separation prevents the isolation contract from being silently coupled to a liveness field someone might later strip down.

====================================================================
DECISION 2 — Response shape
====================================================================
StatusResponse (add to server/types.ts):
  interface StatusResponse {
    agentrackPath: string; // resolved AGENTRACK_CWD || process.cwd() — same value the Tracker singleton used
  }

Field name is `agentrackPath` (per spec), NOT `cwd`, so the guard reads semantically: body.agentrackPath.

====================================================================
PART A — Endpoint (file-by-file)
====================================================================
1. server/routes/status.ts (NEW):
   - `import { cwd } from "../utils/tracker.js"` and `import type { StatusResponse } from "../types.js"`.
   - `const status = new Hono();`
   - `status.get("/", (c) => c.json<StatusResponse>({ agentrackPath: cwd }));`
   - `export default status;`
   - Reusing the exported `cwd` guarantees the endpoint and the Tracker singleton can NEVER drift.

2. server/index.ts:
   - `import statusRoute from "./routes/status.js";`
   - `app.route("/api/status", statusRoute);`

3. server/types.ts:
   - Add `StatusResponse` interface (above).
   - Remove `cwd` from `HealthResponse` (Decision 1). HealthResponse becomes { status: "ok"; tracker: "initialized" | "not_initialized" }.

4. server/routes/health.ts:
   - Remove the `cwd` import and the `cwd` field from the response. Remove the now-stale isolation-guard comment.

====================================================================
PART B — Guard (file-by-file)
====================================================================
5. e2e/global-setup.ts (REWRITE the isolation half; keep waitForBackend):
   - Keep the existing waitForBackend() poll on /api/health (liveness). Playwright guarantees webServers start BEFORE globalSetup, so the fetch has a target — but keep the poll as the readiness gate.
   - After waitForBackend(), fetch http://localhost:${BACKEND_PORT}/api/status.
   - Fetch-failure fallback (per spec): if the /api/status fetch itself fails or returns non-2xx AFTER waitForBackend succeeded, treat as "isolation UNVERIFIED -> abort". Do NOT fall through to running tests. Reason: waitForBackend already proved the server is reachable; a /status failure at that point means the server is the wrong server (no /status route = stale dev build) or something intercepted the request — either way, unsafe to seed.
   - Read body as { agentrackPath?: string }.
   - expected = getE2EDataDir().
   - If body.agentrackPath !== expected -> THROW with a clear message naming both paths and the port.
   - NOTE the spec says "compare to real <projectRoot>/.agentrack and abort if they match". Implementing it as "abort unless === getE2EDataDir()" is STRICTLY STRONGER (allowlist of one) and matches the existing guard's intent. Recommend the allowlist form; call this out so the validator (mqh2hwfsqg) tests both directions.

6. FIX an existing bug while rewriting global-setup.ts: the current error message on the mismatch branch uses a double-quoted string with `${BACKEND_PORT}` — it will NOT interpolate. The new throw must use a backtick template literal so the port number actually appears in the abort message.

7. Port sourcing (no magic numbers): global-setup already reads `process.env.E2E_BACKEND_PORT ?? "5001"`. To make the single source explicit, ADD `E2E_BACKEND_PORT: "5001"` to the backend webServer env in playwright.config.ts (it currently sets PORT: "5001" but not E2E_BACKEND_PORT, so the guard relies on the default matching). This keeps the guard's port and the webServer's port from drifting.

====================================================================
INVARIANTS (do not break)
====================================================================
- AGENTRACK_CWD is load-bearing: set in playwright.config.ts webServer.env, read in server/utils/tracker.ts. The /status endpoint echoes the RESOLVED value — never re-resolve in the route.
- NEVER add reuseExistingServer: true to either webServer.
- E2E ports 5001/5000 must stay distinct from dev 3001/3000.
- workers: 1 / fullyParallel: false stays (shared file store, unlocked RMW).
- The Tracker instance's cwd is private — the endpoint MUST source cwd from the exported constant in server/utils/tracker.ts, not off the Tracker object.

====================================================================
GOTCHAS
====================================================================
- /status route does not exist on older builds. A stale dev server on 5001 will 404 /api/status — the fetch-failure fallback (step 5) catches exactly this and aborts. Good.
- macOS AirPlay Receiver holds port 5000 locally; `npx playwright test` may fail to bind the frontend. Backend-only validation (curl /api/status) still works. Validator (mqh2hwfsqg) should plan around the 5000/5001 bind.
- Run e2e with `npx playwright test`, never `bunx`.
- `server/index.ts` currently routes comments AND blockages under /api/issues; don't disturb that. Add /api/status as a sibling top-level route.

====================================================================
VALIDATION HOOKS (for mqh2hwfsqg)
====================================================================
- Happy path: AGENTRACK_CWD=validation/.e2edata -> body.agentrackPath ends with "validation/.e2edata", guard passes, suite runs.
- Failure path: start backend WITHOUT AGENTRACK_CWD (resolves to repo root .agentrack) -> guard throws in globalSetup before any test; no seed created.
- Wrong-server path: stale dev server on 5001 without /status route -> fetch fallback aborts.
- Regression: typecheck (cd packages/webapp && npx tsc --noEmit) and existing unit tests still pass after removing cwd from HealthResponse.

====================================================================
SCOPE NOTE
====================================================================
This issue is PLAN-only. Implementation = mqh2hweq9n, validation = mqh2hwfsqg. No code changed here. The interim /health.cwd guard already in global-setup is superseded by this plan; the implementer should remove it as part of migrating to /status.
